title: Independent source and semantic backcheck of Reading final12 ordinary candidates

rows.sourceEnglish: Watch: Follow the Sun Across the Site
rows.currentTarget: Shebella: Follow the Sun Across the Site
rows.originalCandidate: Shebella: Latela letsatsi ho pholletsa le sebaka
rows.candidateBacktranslation: Watch: Follow the sun throughout the site.
rows.recommendedTarget: Shebella: Latela letsatsi ho pholletsa le sebaka
rows.recommendedBacktranslation: Watch: Follow the sun across the site.
rows.reason: Preserves existing Watch prefix and follow/sun/across-site scope; no extra spatial geometry or seasonal claim. Site context makes ordinary place wording defensible.
rows.precisionAndLimits: Unreviewed semantic draft only; no fluent-language approval.

rows.sourceEnglish: A wall or shade cloth can shade a bed longer in winter than in summer. Check the actual shadows before you build or fix a shade structure in place.
rows.currentTarget: A wall or shade cloth can shade a bed longer in winter than in summer. Hlahloba shadows tsa sebele before you build or fix a shade structure in place.
rows.originalCandidate: Lebota kapa shade cloth li ka etsa moriti betheng nako e telele mariha ho feta hlabula. Hlahloba meriti ea sebele pele u haha kapa u tiisa shade structure sebakeng sa eona.
rows.candidateBacktranslation: Wall or shade cloth can make shade on a bed a long time in winter than summer; check actual shadows before building or strengthening the shade structure in its place.
rows.recommendedTarget: Lebota kapa shade cloth di ka etsa moriti ho bed nako e telele mariha ho feta lehlabula. Hlahloba meriti ya sebele pele o haha kapa o fix shade structure sebakeng sa yona.
rows.recommendedBacktranslation: A wall or shade cloth can make shade on a bed for a longer time in winter than summer. Check actual shadows before you build or fix a shade structure in its place.
rows.reason: Use established South African o/ya spelling. Preserve Hlahloba and exact can/OR/winter-versus-summer/before/OR structure. Retain bed explicitly so technical-term metadata matches the actual target; retain fix as the precise fastening-in-place action rather than risk strengthen or introduce tying/bolting.
rows.precisionAndLimits: Wall = Lebota; fix and shade structure retained English with translated in-place context. This is unreviewed code-switching, not a claim that fix is translated.

rows.sourceEnglish: Watch: See Wind and Cold Air on the Map
rows.currentTarget: Shebella: See Wind and Cold Air on the Map
rows.originalCandidate: Shebella: Bona phefo le moea o batang mmapeng
rows.candidateBacktranslation: Watch: See wind and cold air on the map.
rows.recommendedTarget: Shebella: Bona moya le moya o batang mmapeng
rows.recommendedBacktranslation: Watch: See wind and cold air on the map.
rows.reason: Use native established moya rather than Lesotho moea; both wind and air use moya in this current module. Bona supplies the explicit See action. Retain Shebella: exactly.
rows.precisionAndLimits: Native L3 body uses Moya for wind and moya o batang for cold air; this is same-module lexical precedent, not fluency certification.

rows.sourceEnglish: Watch: Draw the Land You Already Have
rows.currentTarget: Shebella: Taka the Land You Already Have
rows.originalCandidate: Shebella: Thala sebaka seo u seng u e-na le sona
rows.candidateBacktranslation: Watch: Draw the area you already have.
rows.recommendedTarget: Shebella: Taka lefatshe leo o seng o ntse o e-na le lona
rows.recommendedBacktranslation: Watch: Draw the land that you already have.
rows.reason: Preserve existing Shebella: Taka, replace only the English remainder. Lefatshe retains land rather than generic area; seng o ntse preserves already-state, not merely now.
rows.precisionAndLimits: Current native Reading body uses lefatsheng la hao for walk your land. No expansion to ownership title or cultivated field.

rows.sourceEnglish: A wall or shade cloth can shade a bed longer in winter than in summer. Check the actual shadows before you build or fix a shade structure in place.
rows.currentTarget: A wall or shade cloth can shade a bed longer in winter than in summer. Sedzani shadows dza vhukuma before you build or fix a shade structure in place.
rows.originalCandidate: Luṱango kana shade cloth zwi nga ita murunzi kha bed tshifhinga tshilapfu nga tshifhinga tsha vhuria u fhira tsha tshilimo. Sedzani murunzi wa vhukuma musi ni sa athu fhaṱa kana u khwaṱhisa shade structure fhethu hayo.
rows.candidateBacktranslation: Fence or shade cloth can make shade on a bed longer in winter than summer; inspect real shade before building or strengthening the structure in its place.
rows.recommendedTarget: Luvhondo kana shade cloth zwi nga ita murunzi kha bed tshifhinga tshilapfu nga tshifhinga tsha vhuria u fhira tsha tshilimo. Sedzani mirunzi ya vhukuma musi ni sa athu fhaṱa kana u fix shade structure fhethu hayo.
rows.recommendedBacktranslation: A wall or shade cloth can make shade on a bed for a longer time in winter than summer. Check actual shadows before building or fixing a shade structure in its place.
rows.reason: Luṱango risks fence instead of wall. Luvhondo is the exact same-module wall precedent. Keep fix English because khwaṱhisa strengthens and does not independently prove fastening in place. Plural mirunzi preserves shadows. Preserve Sedzani and before/build OR fix.
rows.precisionAndLimits: Native Reading L2 body uses Luvhondo kana lilaṱa ḽa murunzi and rationale uses mirunzi ya vhukuma. Borrowed fix stays English; no fastening method added.

rows.sourceEnglish: Watch: See Wind and Cold Air on the Map
rows.currentTarget: Sedzani: See Wind and Cold Air kha Map
rows.originalCandidate: Sedzani: Phepho na muya u rotholelaho kha mapa
rows.candidateBacktranslation: Watch: Wind and cooling/cold air on the map.
rows.recommendedTarget: Sedzani: Vhonani muya na muya wo rotholaho kha mapa
rows.recommendedBacktranslation: Watch: See wind and cold air on the map.
rows.reason: Original candidate names wind/cold air but omits explicit See; add Vhonani. Use same-module muya/wo rotholaho lexical precedent and preserve existing kha locative prefix.
rows.precisionAndLimits: Native Reading L3 uses muya for wind; native L2 uses muya wo rotholaho for cold air. Repeated muya has the same context disambiguation as native, not a new weather category.

rows.sourceEnglish: Watch: Draw the Land You Already Have
rows.currentTarget: Sedzani: Draw the Land You Already Have

rows.recommendedBacktranslation: Watch: Draw the land that you already have.
rows.reason: Candidate lacks explicit already and substitutes generic place. Preserve Olani ordinary action, retain precise land/already anchors where possession/aspect concord is not independently certain; avoid introducing owned-title/property legal meaning.
rows.precisionAndLimits: This is a bounded mixed-language draft, not a whole-English hold. Exact land and already anchors expressly disclosed; a fluent ordinary replacement can follow later.

rows.sourceEnglish: A wall or shade cloth can shade a bed longer in winter than in summer. Check the actual shadows before you build or fix a shade structure in place.
rows.currentTarget: A wall or shade cloth can shade a bed longer in winter than in summer. Kambela shadows ta xiviri before you build or fix a shade structure in place.
rows.originalCandidate: Rirhangu kumbe shade cloth swi nga endla ndzhuti ehenhla ka bed nkarhi wo leha hi xixika ku hundza hi le ximumu. Kambela mindzhuti ya xiviri u nga si aka kumbe u tiyisa shade structure endhawini ya yona.
rows.candidateBacktranslation: Wall or shade cloth can make shade over a bed longer in winter than summer; inspect actual shadows before building or strengthening the shade structure in its place.
rows.recommendedTarget: Rirhangu kumbe shade cloth swi nga endla ndzhuti ehenhla ka bed nkarhi wo leha hi xixika ku hundza hi le ximumu. Kambela mindzhuti ya xiviri u nga si aka kumbe u fix shade structure endhawini ya yona.
rows.recommendedBacktranslation: A wall or shade cloth can make shade over a bed for longer in winter than summer. Check actual shadows before building or fixing a shade structure in its place.
rows.reason: Can swi nga, alternative kumbe and ku hundza comparison are present. Tiyisa may strengthen rather than fix in place; retain fix English while translating before/build/OR/in-place framing. Preserve Kambela.
rows.precisionAndLimits: Rirhangu is wall; shade cloth, bed, fix, shade structure remain English. No means of anchoring, duration number or guaranteed shade introduced.

rows.sourceEnglish: Watch: See Wind and Cold Air on the Map
rows.currentTarget: Languta: See Wind and Cold Air eka Map
rows.originalCandidate: Languta: Mheho ni moya wo titimela emepeni
rows.candidateBacktranslation: Watch: Wind and cold air on the map.
rows.recommendedTarget: Languta: Vona moya ni moya wo titimela eka mepe
rows.recommendedBacktranslation: Watch: See wind and cold air on the map.
rows.reason: Original candidate omits explicit See; add Vona. Use existing native moya for wind and preserve the current eka locative instead of unnecessary locative rewrite.
rows.precisionAndLimits: Current native Intro/Reading use moya for wind and mepe for map. This preserves wind AND cold air without changing to temperature or frost.

rows.sourceEnglish: Watch: Draw the Land You Already Have
rows.currentTarget: Languta: Dirowa the Land You Already Have
rows.originalCandidate: Languta: Dirowa ndhawu leyi u nga na yona sweswi
rows.candidateBacktranslation: Watch: Draw the place you have now.
rows.recommendedTarget: Languta: Dirowa misava leyi se u nga na yona
rows.recommendedBacktranslation: Watch: Draw the land you already have.
rows.reason: Sweswi is now rather than already. Se supplies the existing state; misava is land in this mapping context. Preserve existing Languta: Dirowa.
rows.precisionAndLimits: Native Reading uses misava ya wena for your land. Mapping context disambiguates land from a soil-material instruction; no replanting/property acquisition meaning added.

preservationRequirements: Exact canonical English and all unlisted native/paired fields must remain untouched.
Three existing Watch prefixes and existing ST Taka / TS Dirowa must remain.
Retained English technical/action anchors must have truthful provenance; not marked individually as translated.
Do not copy these full targets into learner fields with different source sentences.
limits: Language review uses separate backtranslation and same-module lexical precedent; no fluent speaker approval.
No repository edits, renders, tests, browser actions, commits or publication.
No new farming numbers, methods, species or geometry prescriptions.
